question: Ceará Governor Election Winner
resolution_criteria:
The Ceará gubernatorial election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026, with a runoff on October 25, 2026, if no candidate receives a majority of the valid votes in the first round.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder governors appointed by any means before the specified election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., www.tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes).

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
Ciro Gomes (PSDB) and the incumbent governor Elmano de Freitas (PT) are in a near tie four days before the first round. Ciro led clearly through August. Every poll fielded in mid to late September has the gap inside the margin of error, and the newest one has Elmano slightly ahead. Of the listed names, only Elmano and Ciro are on the governor ballot. Capitão Wagner is running for Senate. I found no sign that Camilo Santana, Eduardo Girão or Roberto Cláudio are running for governor.

## 1. Resolution source
- Official results will be on the TSE results portal (tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes). Before October 4 it holds no 2026 results. I did not fetch it, because a fetch today would show data from after the September 30 cutoff.
- First round is October 4, 2026; the runoff is October 25 if nobody gets a majority of valid votes.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the race.
- 2026-09-28: Eight candidates are on the ballot: Ciro, Elmano, Delegado Huggo (Missão), Vera Lúcia (Novo), Danilo Soares, Zé Batista, Ieri Braga and Serley Leal. All six minor candidates poll at about 1% or less, so a decision in the first round is plausible. Capitão Wagner (União) is running for Senate, not governor. [Poder360](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes-2026/ciro-gomes-tem-46-e-elmano-422-no-1o-turno-no-ceara-diz-pesquisa/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-29: AtlasIntel (1,800 interviews, September 23 to 28, margin 3 points): Elmano 49%, Ciro 47.6%. Valid votes: Elmano 50.3%, Ciro 48.9%. Runoff: Elmano 49.6%, Ciro 48.6%. [DGABC](https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4349768/elmano-de-freitas-tem-49-e-ciro-gomes-soma-47-6-no-ceara-segundo-a-atlas)
- 2026-09-29: Reports conflict on whether Ciro and Elmano skipped the TV Cidade debate. [O Povo](https://mais.opovo.com.br/jornal/politica/2026/09/29/ciro-e-elmano-faltam-a-debate-vera-lucia-e-delegado-huggo-ficam-frente-a-frente.html), [Diário do Nordeste](https://diariodonordeste.verdesmares.com.br/pontopoder/ciro-e-elmano-protagonizam-embate-sobre-seguranca-publica-educacao-e-geracao-de-empregos-1.3795030)
- 2026-09-26: Paraná Pesquisas (September 23 to 25, margin 2.7 points): Ciro 46.0%, Elmano 42.2%. [Poder360](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes-2026/ciro-gomes-tem-46-e-elmano-422-no-1o-turno-no-ceara-diz-pesquisa/)
- 2026-09-25: Datafolha: Ciro 44%, Elmano 43%, a statistical tie for the first time. Runoff: Ciro 48%, Elmano 46%. The previous Datafolha (September 18) had Ciro 47%, Elmano 40%. [O Povo](https://mais.opovo.com.br/jornal/politica/2026/09/25/datafolha-mostra-ciro-com-44-e-elmano-43-empatados-tecnicamente-pela-1-vez.html), [Diário do Nordeste](https://diariodonordeste.verdesmares.com.br/pontopoder/datafolha-ciro-tem44-e-elmano-43-no-1-turno-candidatos-estao-em-empate-tecnico-1.3794162)
- 2026-09-23: Quaest (900 interviews, September 19 to 22): Ciro 43% (down 2), Elmano 41% (up 7). Runoff: Ciro 45%, Elmano 42%. Rejection: Elmano 41%, Ciro 40% (up 5). Quaest's early September round had Ciro 45%, Elmano 34%. [O Povo](https://mais.opovo.com.br/jornal/politica/2026/09/24/pesquisa-quaest-ceara-tem-ciro-com-43-e-elmano-com-41-em-empate-tecnico.html)
- 2026-09-08: Real Time Big Data: Elmano 46%, Ciro 43%; runoff Elmano 47%, Ciro 46%. [Prediction Hunt](https://prediction.com/news/new-poll-cuts-ciro-gomes-cear-win-odds-8-points-sep-11-2026)
- 2026-08-13 to 08-20: Ciro was well ahead in most polls: Datafolha 52% to 33%, Ipsos-Ipec 43% to 35%. The exception was Real Time Big Data, which had them tied at 44% each. [Movimento Econômico](https://movimentoeconomico.com.br/politica/2026/08/14/datafolha-ciro-lidera-disputa-pelo-governo-do-ceara-com-52-elmano-tem-33/), [SBT News](https://sbtnews.sbt.com.br/noticia/politica/real-time-no-ceara-ciro-e-elmano-tem-44-cada-no-1-turno)
- 2026-07-30: Quaest had Ciro 43%, Elmano 33%. [Brasil de Fato](https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/07/30/em-nova-pesquisa-quaest-ciro-gomes-lidera-disputa-pelo-governo-do-ceara-com-43-enquanto-elmano-registra-33/)

## 4. Base rates
- The PT and Camilo Santana group has won every Ceará governor race since 2014: Camilo in 2014 and 2018, and Elmano in 2022 in the first round with about 54%. This is from my background knowledge; I did not re-check it this session.
- Brazilian governors who run for re-election usually win. I did not verify an exact 2022 figure.
- Ciro was governor of Ceará from 1991 to 1994. His Senate-race partner Cid Gomes is polling at 45%. [Poder360](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes-2026/ciro-gomes-tem-46-e-elmano-422-no-1o-turno-no-ceara-diz-pesquisa/)
- The trend over the last six weeks clearly favours Elmano: a lead of 10 to 19 points for Ciro in August has shrunk to between Ciro +4 and Elmano +1.4.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-07: Polymarket had Ciro at 63%. [Prediction Hunt](https://prediction.com/news/new-poll-cuts-ciro-gomes-cear-win-odds-8-points-sep-11-2026)
- 2026-09-11: Polymarket had Ciro at 55% and Kalshi at 60%, a combined 58%. [Prediction Hunt](https://prediction.com/news/new-poll-cuts-ciro-gomes-cear-win-odds-8-points-sep-11-2026)
- Undated snapshots, probably August or early September: Polymarket Ciro 70%, Elmano 27%, Camilo 2.3%, Girão 1.3%; Kalshi Ciro 65%, Elmano 32%. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/cear-governor-election-winner), [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxcearagov/cear-gubernatorial-election/kxcearagov-26oct04)
- I could not find market prices from late September, after the polls converged. There is also a Manifold market. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Brierbr/brazil-2026-election-who-will-be-el-5NszR9An89)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The final debate, probably TV Verdes Mares in the last days of the campaign.
- Final Quaest, Datafolha, AtlasIntel and Ipec polls around October 2 to 3.
- First round on October 4. Because the minor candidates are so weak, a first-round winner is quite possible; otherwise a runoff on October 25.
- National swing effects from the Lula presidential race and Lula's involvement in Ceará.

- 2026-09-23, Quaest: Ciro 43%, Elmano 41%. The early September round had Ciro 45%, Elmano 34%.
- Ciro led by 10 to 19 points in August. That lead has collapsed, and the trend points one way.
- In September, Polymarket and Kalshi had Ciro at 55% to 60%. I found no prices after the polls converged, so I do not anchor strongly on them.

**Moving from the base rate:**
- I start at about 70% for the incumbent's group.
- I move down because Ciro is a strong former governor and still holds a narrow lead in the poll average, about Ciro +1.5.
- I move back up because of the strong momentum toward Elmano, the newest high-quality poll showing him ahead, the PT machine and Lula's strength in Ceará, and 2022, when polls underestimated Elmano.
- Net result: Elmano about 55%, Ciro about 42%.

**(e) Unexpected scenario:** A candidate is disqualified by an electoral court ruling, or a serious health event or scandal forces a substitution. The replacement, possibly Camilo Santana stepping in for the PT or another figure, could then win. Alternatively, results could be contested or delayed past the deadline, which would resolve the market to "Other". All of these are very unlikely.

(e) **Unexpected outcome:**
- A Ciro win remains very plausible. Late anti-PT consolidation, a good final debate or polls overstating Elmano's momentum could produce it.
- A truly unexpected outcome would need something like a candidacy being annulled by the electoral court, or the death or withdrawal of a leading candidate, letting a replacement such as Camilo Santana step in. That would put the result under "Other" or a listed non-candidate.

**Reasoning:** I start from the incumbent and PT-machine base rate of roughly 65 to 70% for Elmano. The race is a tie on the polls, which pulls that down, but the trend and the most recent high-quality poll both favour Elmano. I put Elmano a little above even, at about 54%. Ciro gets most of the rest, and I leave small residual probability on the non-candidate options for tail scenarios.

(d) **Strongest evidence:**
- **AtlasIntel, September 29:** Elmano 50.3% of valid votes against Ciro 48.9%, and Elmano 49.6% to 48.6% in a runoff. AtlasIntel has a good accuracy record in Brazil.
- **Datafolha, September 25:** Ciro 44%, Elmano 43%, down from Ciro +7 a week earlier.
- **Quaest, September 23:** Ciro 43%, Elmano 41%, down from Ciro +11 in early September.
- **Paraná Pesquisas, September 26:** Ciro +3.8.
- **Trend:** Ciro led by 10 to 19 points in August, and the race is now between Ciro +4 and Elmano +1.4. Momentum clearly favours Elmano.
- **Markets:** Prices were stale, with Ciro at 55 to 60% on September 11, before the polls converged. I move away from that anchor because of the late-September polling the market had not priced in at that time.

(e) **Unexpected outcome:** A candidate could be disqualified or face a legal challenge, or have a health event, and be replaced by an unlisted candidate ("Other"). Alternatively, the TSE could annul the result, pushing resolution past the deadline. Both are very unlikely.

**Overall:** The momentum, incumbency, the PT machine and AtlasIntel's accuracy favour Elmano. The poll average is still near even, so Ciro keeps a substantial chance.
